extDescription.message: Speeds up videos with a configurable default speed, boosts volume beyond the native max, and lets you ignore specific sites.

popupStatusIgnored.message: This site is on the ignore list.

popupStatusActive.message: Videos will play at $SPEED$x, volume at $VOLUME$%.

optionsSpeedLabel.message: Default speed applied to all videos

optionsVolumeHint.message: 100% = normal video volume. Above 100% amplifies audio beyond the browser's native max (via the Web Audio API).

optionsIgnoreListHint.message: Accepts a domain ("example.com"), a wildcard ("*.example.com"), or a URL snippet ("example.com/path"). Neither speed nor volume gain is changed on these sites.
